title: Refining a Batch
text:
A batch can use a single plant or several, as long as it meets the recipe requirements. There is no general minimum or maximum number of species. Starter T1 recipes require at least one T1 or higher plant.

Each plant contributes its spiritual growth multiplied by stack count to its element's score. Qi-source reserves do not count toward these scores. Every input stack is consumed when the batch finishes.

Missing mandatory requirements ruins the batch. Even a correct recipe can fail. Failed batches cause a small explosion that damages nearby creatures and the refiner, without breaking blocks or starting fires.
